Home/Installations & additions

Installations & additions

A home that works
the way you do.

New fittings, more useful outlets, and thoughtful additions to the spaces you use every day.

Plan an installation
01

Start with the everyday.

Where do you charge a phone, work from home, or plug in the vacuum? Practical improvements begin with those small routines. A carefully placed outlet or a better-positioned switch can make a room easier to use.

02

Plan the details together.

The existing wiring, circuit capacity, access, and local requirements all affect the work. Discuss your intended equipment and the locations you have in mind before buying fittings or arranging other trades.

  • Outlet and switch positions
  • The equipment or appliances you plan to use
  • Access to walls, ceilings, and existing circuits
03

Leave room for the next change.

A useful plan considers how you might use the space later as well as what you need today. Confirm the agreed work, finish, testing, and any documentation before installation begins.
